title: App Fails New Customers
body: Many new Mashreq Bank customers likely join this financial institution via a new credit card. This should make Mashreq Bank quite happy given their aggressive credit card sales program. Unfortunately, the app doesn’t mention ‘credit card activation’ on its front page. There are no prompts, no way to access customer service support through the app unless you either have an active Mashreq account with a current Mashreq user ID and password; or you sign up as a new user. Unbeknownst to me, a loan salesman had signed me up to a Mashreq Gold account years ago. I didn’t get the loan but the account apparently remained active. I never had a user ID or password so I couldn’t sign in. I tried to request new ones but this requires a 16 digit credit card. Can’t use that - not activated yet because I cannot sign in to app. The only recourse for my issue is to seek help from customer service. The app doesn’t provide a method to do that unless you sign in. This methodology (or lack thereof) is flawed resulting in unnecessary frustration. The app is supposed to be the centerpiece of Mashreq Bank customer service. It fails.
